integrity: The proof is universal and exhausts prime powers and all two-prime-support factorizations with arbitrary exponents. The attached finite computation is corroborative only and is not used to infer the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers composite integers with \(\omega(n)\le2\) only and does not settle the open problem for three or more distinct prime factors. Classical Lehmer results are stronger on the squarefree subcase but do not cover the nonsquarefree cases handled here.
title: Two-prime-support barrier for Tóth's alternating Lehmer problem
